name: FlightRadar24 API
tagline: Commercial flight tracking API with live aircraft positions and historical flight data.
description: FlightRadar24's commercial API provides live aircraft positions, flight status, airport and airline data, and historical flight information for developers integrating real-time and archived aviation tracking into applications.

auth.details: API key via Authorization or X-Api-Key header; commercial signup required (verify on docs).

use_cases: get live aircraft positions near an airport
look up flight status by callsign or flight number
query historical flights for a route or airport
track aircraft by registration or FR24 id
